summary: Completed comprehensive testing of DELETE endpoints, Cancel intervention, PDF downloads, Dashboard stats, and UI buttons. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified with all buttons visible and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE endpoints properly restrict deletion based on status (devis: brouillon/envoye, interventions: non-started, factures: brouillon)
Cancel intervention endpoint works correctly and updates status to 'annulee'
PDF download with token authentication working for both devis and factures
Dashboard stats correctly counts interventions_today (only today's date)
Signature visible in devis detail and PDF generation
Voir devis button visible on factures created from devis
seed_data_creation: Created test interventions, devis, and factures during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features tested and working: 1) DELETE /api/devis/{id} - works for brouillon/envoye status, returns 400 for signed devis. 2) DELETE /api/interventions/{id} - works for planifiee status, returns 400 for en_cours/terminee. 3) DELETE /api/factures/{id} - works for brouillon status only. 4) DELETE /api/users/{id} - works for technicians without active interventions. 5) POST /api/interventions/{id}/cancel - works correctly, updates status to annulee. 6) GET /api/devis/{id}/pdf-download?token=xxx - returns PDF with attachment header. 7) GET /api/factures/{id}/pdf-download?token=xxx - returns PDF with attachment header. 8) Dashboard stats interventions_today counts only today's interventions. 9) UI buttons verified: Annuler/Supprimer on intervention detail (planifiee), Lien client/Supprimer on devis detail (brouillon/envoye), Voir devis on facture detail (when created from devis), Supprimer on facture detail (brouillon). 10) Signature visible in devis detail after signing. 11) Dashboard alerts clickable with navigation to detail pages. 12) Planning scrollable on mobile.
